title: Reuse bounded discovery for a shared unknown

rubric.text: Checks the supplied current evidence first and reuses it only where it answers the concrete question; avoids repeating the already-settled compatibility finding.
Identifies the unresolved behavior as common to owners B and C and investigates it once, using the lead or one justified bounded read-only helper rather than asking both owners to rediscover it.

Records source and base identity, findings, limits and remaining questions in the existing delivery context or accessible notes; the helper writes notes only when its runtime permits it and the destination is explicitly authorized, or the lead records returned evidence.
Shares the evidence reference only with B and C, lets independent ready task A proceed, and keeps source edits and implementation decisions with their existing owners.
Provides a read-only review plan and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
